newsitem.title: GERMANY: DOPING-GERMANY PLANS TO MAKE DOPING A CRIMINAL OFFENCE.
newsitem.headline: DOPING-GERMANY PLANS TO MAKE DOPING A CRIMINAL OFFENCE.

text.p: Germany plans to make doping in sport a criminal offence, the country's health ministry said on Thursday.
The German parliament is expected to discuss changes in the law next year which would make it illegal to trade in banned performance-enhancing drugs or supply them to athletes.
The proposal has the support of both the government and opposition and is expected to come before parliament early next year.
German public prosecutors are investigating about 50 people for allegedly using banned drugs to boost the performances of Olympic athletes in the former East Germany.
